description: Source code for managing temporary object directories in a Git-like system, including creation, destruction, migration, and environment setup.

classes.name: tmp_objdir
classes.description: Structure representing a temporary object directory, including repository reference, path, environment variables, previous source, and destruction flag.

methods.name: tmp_objdir_free
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a tmp_objdir instance.

methods.name: tmp_objdir_destroy
methods.description: Destroys a tmp_objdir, restoring previous sources and removing directories.

methods.name: remove_tmp_objdir
methods.description: Callback to remove the global temporary object directory.

methods.name: tmp_objdir_discard_objects
methods.description: Removes the directory associated with the tmp_objdir without destroying the structure.

methods.name: env_append
methods.description: Appends a value to an environment variable, quoting if necessary.

methods.name: env_replace
methods.description: Replaces an environment variable with a new value.

methods.name: setup_tmp_objdir
methods.description: Creates a 'pack' directory inside the given root path.

methods.name: tmp_objdir_create
methods.description: Creates a new temporary object directory, setting environment variables and handling cleanup handlers.

methods.name: pack_copy_priority
methods.description: Determines priority for copying pack files based on filename suffix.

methods.name: pack_copy_cmp
methods.description: Comparison function for sorting pack files by priority.

methods.name: read_dir_paths
methods.description: Reads directory entries into a string list, ignoring hidden files.

methods.name: migrate_paths
methods.description: Migrates object files from source to destination paths, handling directories and files.

methods.name: migrate_one
methods.description: Migrates a single object file or directory.

methods.name: is_loose_object_shard
methods.description: Checks if a filename corresponds to a loose object shard.

methods.name: tmp_objdir_migrate
methods.description: Migrates all objects in the tmp_objdir to the main object directory.

methods.name: tmp_objdir_env
methods.description: Returns environment variables for the tmp_objdir.

methods.name: tmp_objdir_add_as_alternate
methods.description: Adds the tmp_objdir as an alternate object database.

methods.name: tmp_objdir_replace_primary_odb
methods.description: Replaces the primary object database with the tmp_objdir.

methods.name: tmp_objdir_unapply_primary_odb
methods.description: Restores the previous primary object database.

methods.name: tmp_objdir_reapply_primary_odb
methods.description: Reapplies the primary object database with a new working directory context.
